name: Stormwind Ho!
summary: Alliance High Command fears the naga threat, and Stormwind Ho! gives Farren Orinelle a way south. He hopes to claim their defeat and win a return to Stormwind City.

sections.title: A Ticket Out of Southshore
sections.body:
Lieutenant Farren Orinelle finds his post in Southshore miserable. The town lies on Lordaeron’s edge, hemmed in by Forsaken forces, syndicate brigands, and sea fiends. Farren once served as a city guardsman in Stormwind, where his days meant drunks and petty brawls. Now he longs to return south.

His former mentor tells him Alliance High Command grows anxious about naga encroaching on the coasts. Farren sees a chance to leave the north behind.

sections.title: Stolen Valor on the Coast
sections.body:
Farren admits he lacks the courage and skill to face Daggerspine sirens and shorehunters in open combat. So he sends you to scour the beaches southeast of Southshore and thin the naga ranks.

He needs your deeds for an impressive dispatch to Major Samuelson in Stormwind. With that credit, Farren hopes to secure a reassignment.

faq.q: Why does Farren Orinelle want to kill the naga?
faq.answer: Farren wants to escape Southshore, not because he cares about the naga. His mentor says Alliance High Command fears their growing threat, so success against them might win Farren a promotion or a transfer to Stormwind City.

faq.q: Can Lieutenant Farren Orinelle fight the naga himself?
faq.answer: No. Farren served as an urban guardsman, breaking up drunken tavern brawls and arresting rowdy beggars. The savage Daggerspine naga frighten him, so he relies on travelers to fight them.

faq.q: Where are the Daggerspine naga located?
faq.answer: Daggerspine shorehunters and sirens keep encampments along the coast southeast of Southshore. They prowl the Great Sea shores in Hillsbrad Foothills.
Major Samuelson was Farren Orinelle’s mentor in the Stormwind City Guard. As Farren prepares a report about the naga, he hopes Samuelson will use his influence to secure a transfer south.

faq.q: What happens after completing this task?
faq.answer: After the naga threat is reduced, Farren claims credit for your work and sends you south to Stormwind Keep. There, you deliver his report and plea for reassignment to Major Samuelson in person.

faq.q: Why does Farren hate Southshore so much?
faq.answer: Farren sees Southshore as a dangerous frontier outpost, far from Stormwind’s safety. With undead neighbors and coastal monsters all around, he bitterly calls it a “Light-forsaken port.”

angles.text: Alliance command in Hillsbrad is stretched thin. Ordinary city watchmen are out of their depth against monstrous threats like the Daggerspine naga.
As a human serving in Lordaeron, you see Southshore as a grim reminder of lost northern glory, far from Stormwind’s rebuilt grandeur and safety.
